about:
Vermont Teddy Bear Factory operates from Shelburne, Vermont. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed in the provided sources. The business began as a maker of custom teddy bears and stuffed animals, with a focus on assembly in Vermont using components sourced internationally.

The company produces a wide range of plush toys, including teddy bears in sizes from 13 inches to 6 feet, as well as specialty animals such as cows, unicorns, dinosaurs, and seasonal characters. Products are assembled in Vermont from parts made abroad, and the facility also operates a "Bear Hospital" that provides free lifetime repairs for any purchased plush. No details on facility size, headcount, or annual volume are available.

Vermont Teddy Bear Factory sells directly to consumers through its e-commerce website, offering gifts for occasions such as holidays, birthdays, and awareness campaigns (e.g., breast cancer awareness). The company does not list specific B2B industries or wholesale customers in the provided material.

The brand emphasizes a lifetime guarantee and free repairs as a core differentiator, positioning its products as heirloom-quality keepsakes. The "Assembled in Vermont" label and the Bear Hospital service are highlighted as reasons customers choose the company.
